# 1. Great Suez Maritime Canal (suez)
oe_v49_wdr_suez_canal = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	in_empty = owned
	max_levels = 3
	increase_per_level_cost = 1
	audio_tier = 5
	icon = pound_lock_canal_infrastructure
	pop_type = laborers
	employment_size = 0.25
	category = infrastructure_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	expensive = yes
	build_time = 912
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	location_potential = {
		this = location:suez
		has_owner = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
	}
	country_potential = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		is_rebel_country = no
		owns = location:suez
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_v49_wdr_suez_canal_maint = {
			masonry = 0.2
			tools = 0.15
			lumber = 0.12
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	construction_demand = pound_lock_canal_infrastructure_construction

	modifier = {
		local_trade_center_power = 0.08
		local_maritime_presence = 0.08
		harbor_suitability = 0.12
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.0006
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 3 }
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				change_development = development_mild_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 15
						add_legitimacy = 5
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_large_effect = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 2 }
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				change_development = development_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 10
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_medium_effect = yes } }
		}
		else = {
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 6
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_rebel_country = no
								NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_suez_canal_ev_done }
							}
							set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_suez_canal_ev_done value = 1 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_v49_wdr.1 days = 2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_small_effect = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# 5. New Hagia Sophia Dome of the New World (capital-adaptive Americas Christian/Greek)
oe_v49_wdr_nova_hagia_sophia = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	in_empty = owned
	max_levels = 3
	increase_per_level_cost = 1
	audio_tier = 5
	icon = cathedral
	pop_type = clergy
	employment_size = 0.25
	category = religious_category
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	expensive = yes
	build_time = 912
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	location_potential = {
		is_capital = yes
		continent = continent:america
		has_owner = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		owner ?= {
			OR = {
				religion.group = religion_group:christian
				culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
			}
		}
	}
	country_potential = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		is_rebel_country = no
		capital ?= { continent = continent:america }
		OR = {
			religion.group = religion_group:christian
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		is_capital = yes
		has_owner = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		OR = {
			has_building = building_type:oe_v49_wdr_nova_hagia_sophia
			owner ?= {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_location = {
						has_building = building_type:oe_v49_wdr_nova_hagia_sophia
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_v49_wdr_nova_hagia_sophia_maint = {
			marble = 0.16
			glass = 0.14
			incense = 0.1
			category = building_maintenance

		local_cultural_tradition = 0.1
		local_cultural_influence = 0.1
		local_max_control = 0.03
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.0006
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 3 }

			}

		}

				change_development = development_weak_bonus
				if = {

			paper = 0.16
			naval_supplies = 0.14
			pepper = 0.08
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	construction_demand = port_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_trade_center_power = 0.08
		local_maritime_presence = 0.08
		local_merchant_capacity_modifier = 0.06
		local_institution_growth_modifier = 0.05
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 3 }
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				change_development = development_mild_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 15
						add_legitimacy = 5
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_large_effect = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 2 }
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				change_development = development_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 10
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_medium_effect = yes } }
		}
		else = {
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 6
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_rebel_country = no
								NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_lisbon_casa_india_ev_done }
							}
							set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_lisbon_casa_india_ev_done value = 1 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_v49_wdr.19 days = 2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_small_effect = yes } }

		is_rebel_country = no
		owns = location:axum
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		oe_v49_wdr_aksum_rock_sanctuary_maint = {
			stone = 0.2
			incense = 0.12
			masonry = 0.12
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	construction_demand = cathedral_construction

	modifier = {
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.09
		local_defensive = 0.07
		local_max_control = 0.03
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.0005
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 3 }
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				change_development = development_mild_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 15
						add_legitimacy = 5
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_large_effect = yes } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_level >= 2 }
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				change_development = development_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 10
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_medium_effect = yes } }
		}
		else = {
			location = {
				change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner ?= {
						add_prestige = 6
						oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_rebel_country = no
								NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_aksum_rock_sanctuary_ev_done }
							}
							set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_aksum_rock_sanctuary_ev_done value = 1 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_v49_wdr.25 days = 2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race } situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = { oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_small_effect = yes } }
		}
	}
}
